svg.title: B2B Archiving to a File Server
svg.desc: The Trading Partner Management archiving job uses the destination CloudIntegration_B2BArchive to call iFlow 1 (CMIS File Gateway), which keeps metadata in a Data Store and hands createDocument via ProcessDirect to iFlow 2, which writes the file to the file server via SFTP or SMB.
svg.text: B2B Archiving to a File Server
